title: Circuit for exclusive or
statement:
The Boolean circuit with inputs $x_0,x_1\in\{0,1\}$ has, in order, gates computing $
eg x_0$, $
eg x_1$, $(
eg x_0)\land x_1$, $x_0\land(
eg x_1)$, and $((
eg x_0)\land x_1)\lor(x_0\land(
eg x_1))$. Its output is the value of the fifth gate, so the circuit computes exclusive or.
